correctness.rationale: Every arbitrary weight-zero operator on k[t]/t^4 in characteristic two is proved to have image in (t^2) by the diagonal identity, then forced coefficient vanishings leave exactly cf=0, with all converse basis equations checked. The linear-compatibility theorem follows from pairwise sums and the one-equation normal form. The two coordinate hyperplanes are the complete reduced variety, and finite-field rank polynomials follow from explicit 2-by-2 and 2-by-3 matrix rank counts with inclusion-exclusion. Exhaustive independent basis-equation tests cover all 65536 F2 linear maps, all F2 compatible pairs and triples, and all 65536 maps into the mathematically forced image ideal over F4. Finite tests are not substituted for the general argument.

value.rationale: This answers the concrete algebraically motivated order-four cyclic-group-algebra classification gap left after the order-two/three semigroup-algebra computations: it gives a complete characteristic-two operator classification and a natural reducibility/nonlinear-compatibility boundary. The two maximal compatible operator spaces, all tuple lengths, complete joint-rank polynomial and exact index-three locus are not implied by the already known rank-one and unit-value cases. They organize an entire natural operator variety and provide reproducible finite-field arithmetic invariants, rather than an arbitrary fixed small-case recomputation.
